t: recovery group of southern west virginia will engage a consultant to lead its board and staff members through a comprehensive organizational development process. the consultant will facilitate educational workshops and individual coaching sessions; gather insights through surveys and interviews; and guide rgswv in developing a strategic plan. project healthy kids will provide programming at its central kitchen in huntington, wv, to engage the fairfield neighborhood in addressing food insecurity through child-focused activities. healthy kids will partner with the huntington black pastors ministerial association and unlimited future to host five interactive community cooking demonstrations that will each include the distribution of healthy frozen meals to families in attendance. charleston thunder sled hockey will purchase new jerseys, additional sleds, protective gear, sticks, and wheeled bags for players. funds also will support hospitality costs for the end-of-season celebration. midian leadership project will combine research and practice in the trauma-healing power of team sport participation to address the mental and behavioral health and substance use disorder challenges of youth in low-income, multicultural communities. midian will expand its cohort of young adult coaches employed through up2us sports americorps positions serving west side middle school and capital high school football and basketball teams and engage 150 school athletes and other community youth through trauma-informed coaching; academic mentorship; and year-round nutrition, fitness, and enrichment programming aimed at tapping into youth interests and maintaining positive mentor connections during the offseason. additional midian team members will provide project supervision, manage outcome data collection, and oversee research and evaluation. finally, midian will present insights and applicable strategies at relevant conferences and create training materials to share with coaches, etc. rlb ministries will purchase food for its weekend backpack buddies meal program; children's clothing and hygiene items for distribution at schools; food and basic needs items for the collins career technical center food pantry; and food and basic needs items for students served by lawrence county educational service center. johnson memorial united methodist church will purchase food for weekend meal backpacks distributed to students at explorer academy elementary school. st. vincent mission, inc. will use funds to address needs of individuals who were impacted by flooding in february 2025 in floyd county, ky. funds will be used for a disaster case manager coordinator's salary, fringe, and benefits for approximately eight weeks. funds also will be used for hygiene, cleaning, muck out, food, and building supplies. encounter missions in paintsville, ky, will provide fresh produce and other healthy food items in weekly food bags distributed to people experiencing homelessness in johnson county.  will purchase food community provide county funds also health center recovery used services youth children school staff project west organization items outreach pantry supplies counties healthy virginia training huntington family
